$comment: Authoritative allocation registry for supabase/migrations numeric prefixes. Consumed by tools/scripts/check-migration-prefixes.mjs. To add a NEW migration you must FIRST reserve its number here in its own reviewed change; the guard fails any migration whose number is not listed. See docs/ci/migration-prefix-guard.md and docs/migrations/migration-ledger.md. 'status: applied' means present in the production database (project mamosbzcbigcclafhmmr) as of 2026-06-24 — verified against supabase_migrations.schema_migrations.
